menu_options.account: Set up a Tuya Cloud account (recommended - auto-discovers devices)
menu_options.manual: Add a single device manually (no cloud, no discovery)

account.title: Tuya Cloud project credentials
account.description: From your Tuya IoT Platform project (Cloud > Devices > Link Tuya App Account for the UID). Used only to fetch local_keys and DP schemas - once set up, devices you find on this account appear as "Discovered" cards below, one per device.

discovery_ip.title: {name}: not currently seen on the LAN
discovery_ip.description: This device is known via your Tuya Cloud account but wasn't seen in a broadcast pass just now - make sure it's powered on and on the same network/VLAN, or enter its IP manually.

profile.title: Device profile
profile.description: Auto-detected from the device's real DP schema when available (always review before saving) - or pick a built-in profile / paste your own YAML.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Tuya Cloud API.
error.no_devices_found: No devices found for that linked account (UID).

abort.already_configured: This device (or account) is already configured.
abort.already_in_progress: This device is already waiting to be configured - check your Discovered devices list.
abort.unsupported_protocol_version: This device uses Tuya protocol 3.4/3.5, not implemented yet - see the project README/CHANGELOG for status.

abort.account_entry_no_options: Account entries have nothing to configure here - remove and re-add to change credentials.
